response.sql:
WITH rental_payments AS (
  SELECT 
    r.rental_id,
    i.store_id,
    SUM(p.amount) AS rental_total
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
  LEFT JOIN payment p ON r.rental_id = p.rental_id
  GROUP BY r.rental_id, i.store_id
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_total) AS avg_total
  FROM rental_payments
),
filtered_rentals AS (
  SELECT 
    rp.store_id,
    rp.rental_id,
    rp.rental_total,
    oa.avg_total,
    rp.rental_total - oa.avg_total AS excess
  FROM rental_payments rp
  CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
  WHERE rp.rental_total > oa.avg_total
)
SELECT 
  store_id,
  SUM(rental_total) AS sum_of_totals,
  AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM filtered_rentals
GROUP BY store_id;

assumptions.assumption: Rentals with no linked payments are treated as NULL rental_totals and excluded from the overall average calculation (per 'Averages ignore missing values'). Only rentals with at least one payment are included in the baseline average.

alternatives.interpretation: Rentals with no linked payments should be treated as having a payment total of 0 (not NULL), and should be included in the overall average calculation.
